title: 一百个鸡蛋

lines.text: 杰克很忙，没时间去商店，所以常常在网上买东西。
lines.py: Jié kè hěn máng, méi shí jiān qù shāng diàn, suǒ yǐ cháng cháng zài wǎng shàng mǎi dōng xi.
lines.en: Jack is busy and has no time to go to the shops, so he often buys things online.

tr.vi: Jack rất bận, không có thời gian đi cửa hàng, nên thường mua đồ trên mạng.
tr.pt: Jack é muito ocupado e não tem tempo de ir às lojas, por isso costuma comprar coisas pela internet.
tr.es: Jack está muy ocupado y no tiene tiempo de ir a las tiendas, así que muchas veces compra cosas por internet.
tr.fr: Jack est très occupé et n’a pas le temps d’aller dans les magasins, alors il achète souvent en ligne.

lines.py: xīng qī yì wǎn shang, tā xiǎng mǎi shí gè jī dàn.
lines.en: On Monday evening, he wants to buy ten eggs.

tr.pt: Na segunda-feira à noite, ele quer comprar dez ovos.
tr.es: El lunes por la noche quiere comprar diez huevos.
tr.fr: Lundi soir, il veut acheter dix œufs.

lines.en: He sees some cheap eggs online and, without reading carefully, orders ten.

tr.pt: Ele vê na internet uns ovos baratos e, sem ler direito, compra dez.

lines.en: Jack opens them up. Every box has ten eggs in it!

tr.pt: Jack abre e vê: cada caixa tem dez ovos!
tr.es: Jack las abre: ¡en cada caja hay diez huevos!
tr.fr: Jack les ouvre : dans chaque boîte, il y a dix œufs !

lines.text: 原来，网上的鸡蛋是一盒一盒卖的，他买的不是十个，是十盒。
lines.py: yuán lái, wǎng shàng de jī dàn shì yì hé yì hé mài de, tā mǎi de bú shì shí gè, shì shí hé.
lines.en: It turns out the eggs were sold by the box. He didn't buy ten eggs. He bought ten boxes.

tr.vi: Hóa ra, trứng trên mạng bán theo hộp, anh mua không phải mười quả, mà là mười hộp.
tr.pt: Acontece que os ovos eram vendidos por caixa. Ele não comprou dez ovos, comprou dez caixas.
tr.es: Resulta que en internet los huevos se vendían por caja. No compró diez huevos, sino diez cajas.
tr.fr: En fait, les œufs se vendaient à la boîte : il n’a pas acheté dix œufs, mais dix boîtes.

lines.en: So Jack has no choice but to invite his friends round for dinner on Saturday.

lines.en: Every dish that evening has eggs in it: egg noodles, tomato and egg, egg soup...

tr.fr: Ce soir-là, tous les plats contiennent des œufs : nouilles aux œufs, œufs à la tomate, soupe aux œufs…

lines.en: As they're leaving, Li Qiang asks, "Jack, is there another egg dinner next week?"

tr.pt: Na hora de ir embora, Li Qiang pergunta: “Jack, semana que vem tem outro jantar de ovos?”
